# Recreation Prompt
Recreate a browser-native, mobile portrait friendly canvas match-3 game titled **Dusty Clover and the Snack-Tab Shrine**. Preserve a 6x8 board, 60 second timer, adjacent tap/drag swapping, match-3 detection, invalid rollback, score/cascade rewards, gravity collapse, new tile spawn, game-over at timer zero, and tap restart. Present it as a low-stakes Zelda-inspired western fantasy: Dusty Clover, a friendly cowboy outlaw with a green neckerchief, tidies hats, heart rupees, horseshoes, cacti, boots, and jars on a canyon shrine board to settle a snack-tab bounty before sundown. Use warm sunset mesa backgrounds, parchment HUD, readable mobile copy, procedural canvas art, and light catalog-backed desert/forest audio.
blueprint_markdown:
<!-- Filled v5 blueprint. Keep headings stable. -->

# Source Truth
- genre: timed canvas match-3 / tile-swap arcade puzzle
- objective: swap adjacent pieces to create horizontal or vertical groups of three or more before the 60 second timer expires
- input model: pointer/touch/click on canvas; tap one cell then adjacent cell, or drag from a cell to an adjacent cell
- core loop: initialize 6x8 board without starting matches, select or drag adjacent swap, validate match, roll back invalid swaps, clear valid matches, score, collapse columns, spawn replacements, resolve cascades
- fail/friction state: invalid swaps bounce back with feedback; timer reaching zero displays a game-over overlay and tap restarts

# Protected Mechanics
- 6 columns by 8 rows, 60 second timer, adjacent swap only, match length >= 3, invalid-swap rollback, score formula with 4/5 length multipliers and cascade bonus, fall/spawn animations, tap-to-restart.

# Remix Target
Create a deterministic creative remix in a Zelda inspired style, centered on a cowboy outlaw, but make it low-stakes. Preserve the core playable mechanic loop while rebuilding the theme, identity, surface art, world language, and presentation around this new premise.

# Regeneration Blueprint
Rebuild the public surface as **Dusty Clover and the Snack-Tab Shrine**, a low-stakes cowboy-outlaw puzzle chore in a Zelda-inspired canyon shrine. The player still performs the exact tile-swap loop, but the meaning changes to tidying ranch relics and settling a harmless snack-tab bounty before sundown.

# Safe Theming Surfaces
HUD wording, token art, background, palette, fonts, audio, feedback copy, particle/danmaku callouts, game-over language, and procedural focal actor art are safe to transform.
